title: Ask for a Hugging Face token only when a gated model needs it
goal: Zero-config means zero REQUIRED files or env vars: derive, detect or default; where only the human can supply something (a secret, a consent) ask once at the moment of need, never via a hand-edited file. Detect the gated-model response, explain the licence step and request HF_TOKEN just in time. Tests zc_hf_token_jit_*.
